# Disco

> Disco is the command center for AI enablement — a multiplayer canvas for orchestrating AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, and Cursor in beta) and long-lived AI teammates. It manages branches (isolated workspaces backed by git worktrees or self-standing clones), tracks AI conversations, visualizes work on spatial boards, and enables real-time collaboration.

Disco is source-available software licensed under BSL 1.1. Production use is permitted by its Additional Use Grant; commercializing Disco itself as the defined Disco Offering is not. Each version later converts to Apache License 2.0 under the license terms.

- Website: https://disco.live
- GitHub: https://github.com/preset-io/disco
- Discord: https://discord.gg/Qh4TrFQZpd

## Core Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://disco.live/guide/getting-started): Install Disco and follow the onboarding wizard — your first AI teammate takes it from there
- [Extended Installation](https://disco.live/guide/extended-install): Docker, source builds, authentication options, and custom config locations
- [Architecture](https://disco.live/guide/architecture): System architecture, daemon-based design, typed TypeScript client, data flow
- [SDK Comparison](https://disco.live/guide/sdk-comparison): Feature matrix for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode integrations

## Core Primitives

- [Branches](https://disco.live/guide/branches): Isolated workspaces backed by git worktrees or self-standing clones — the primary unit of work in Disco
- [Sessions & Trees](https://disco.live/guide/sessions): AI conversations that fork, spawn subsessions, and ask side questions (BTW)
- [Boards & Zones](https://disco.live/guide/boards): 2D spatial canvases for organizing branches, with templated zone triggers

## Features

- [Features Overview](https://disco.live/guide/features-overview): Map of all major features
- [Teammates](https://disco.live/guide/teammates): Persistent AI teammates with memory, skills, orchestration, and scheduled heartbeats
- [Knowledge](https://disco.live/guide/knowledge): Built-in knowledge base for shared context, searchable memory, and a doc graph humans and agents use together
- [Disco MCP Server](https://disco.live/guide/internal-mcp): Built-in MCP server — anything a user can do, an agent can do too
- [Rich Chat UX](https://disco.live/guide/rich-chat-ux): Per-prompt token/$ accounting, context viz, tool blocks, queueing, autocomplete, Streamdown
- [In-Conversation Widgets](https://disco.live/guide/in-conversation-widgets): Inline interactive UI in the transcript that captures user input without it entering the LLM's context
- [Multiplayer & Social](https://disco.live/guide/multiplayer-social): Live cursors, facepile, spatial comments, attention pulse, shared terminals
- [Environments](https://disco.live/guide/environment-configuration): Per-branch dev environments with auto-assigned unique ports
- [Scheduler](https://disco.live/guide/scheduler): Cron-driven agent sessions attached to branches
- [Cards](https://disco.live/guide/cards): Generic workflow entities on boards (beta)
- [Artifacts](https://disco.live/guide/artifacts): Live, interactive Sandpack apps rendered on the canvas
- [Message Gateway](https://disco.live/guide/message-gateway): Route messages from Slack and GitHub into Disco sessions

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://disco.live/api-reference): Interactive REST API documentation with Swagger UI
- [WebSocket Events](https://disco.live/api-reference/websockets): Real-time Socket.io event reference for sessions, tasks, messages, and presence
- [TypeScript Client](https://disco.live/guide/typescript-client): Drive Disco from TypeScript/JavaScript with @disco-live/client — REST, real-time Socket.IO, and a reactive session API

## Deployment

- [Execution Isolation](https://disco.live/guide/multiplayer-unix-isolation): RBAC with fail-closed local sandboxing or delegated execution for shared environments
- [Containerized Execution](https://disco.live/guide/containerized-execution): Running Disco executors in Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized environments
- [Development Guide](https://disco.live/guide/development): Contributing to Disco — development environment setup and codebase structure

## Other

- [Security](https://disco.live/security): Practical guidance for operating Disco safely
- [FAQ](https://disco.live/faq): Frequently asked questions about branches, session forking, spawning, and multiplayer workflow
